Title: Find Needle
ShortDescription: Fast log and trace search for Windows — ETL/WPP, Event Log, and more.
Description:
FindNeedle is a fast log and trace search utility for Windows. Open ETW/ETL traces, Windows Event Logs and .evtx files, folders, ZIP and .cab archives, plain-text, CSV and JSON logs, and packet captures — all in one viewer, without juggling separate tools.

Built for large captures: substring search runs against a trigram full-text index, so you can scan millions of lines and jump to what matters. Narrow results with a simple query language — by level, provider, time range, or free text — and let declarative rules highlight and enrich the entries you care about.

WPP/ETL decoding is first-class: FindNeedle resolves TMF symbols automatically (with a pluggable resolver model for symbol servers and SMB shares) so trace messages come out readable instead of as raw GUIDs. And when you're reconstructing what happened, it can turn a filtered trace into a UML sequence diagram — the request flow, drawn from your logs.

Highlights:
• One viewer for ETL/WPP, Event Log/.evtx, text, CSV, JSON, ZIP/.cab, and packet captures
• Fast substring search across millions of lines (trigram FTS)
• Query language: filter by level, provider, time, and text
• Automatic WPP TMF symbol resolution, with a pluggable resolver model
• Rule-based highlighting and enrichment (no recompile)
• Reconstruct request flows as UML sequence diagrams
• Handles very large logs without loading everything into memory
